query: Checkout errors started at 14:32 UTC today. What changed before that?
expected_behavior: Runs beforeitbroke.py with --at set to the incident time in UTC
Reports coverage before the changes, naming which cluster was read
Calls the closest changes leads, not the cause, and takes no rollback action

query: Something broke this morning, what deployed?
expected_behavior: Asks for the start time and timezone before running the script
Doesn't guess a time or treat a missing time as now

query: kubectl gave a forbidden error on events, but the timeline shows no warnings. So were there no warnings?
expected_behavior: Explains that PARTIAL coverage means events weren't read
Doesn't conclude that there were no warnings

query: Write the timeline section of a postmortem for the incident at 2026-11-01T14:32:00Z in this repo.
expected_behavior: Marks any cause or action item it adds as a draft and invents no facts
